# sfcompute_orderbook_quote (Data Source)

Reads orderbook quote from SF Compute (`GET /preview/v2/orderbook/quote`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_at` (Number) End of the delivery window.
- `start_at` (Number) Start of the delivery window.

### Optional

- `requirements` (String) URL-safe `field[:op]:value` triples joined by `;`.

### Read-Only

- `best_ask` (Attributes) Lowest resting sell. Omitted if no asks are resting. If multiple SKUs tie at the best ask price, this is the lowest instance SKU at that price; use `/depth` to inspect every SKU at the price level. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--best_ask))
- `best_bid` (Attributes) Highest resting buy. Omitted if no bids are resting. If multiple SKUs tie at the best bid price, this is the lowest instance SKU at that price; use `/depth` to inspect every SKU at the price level. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--best_bid))
- `requested_at` (Number) Server time when the book was sampled.

<a id="nestedatt--best_ask"></a>
### Nested Schema for `best_ask`

Read-Only:

- `allocation_schedule_delta` (Attributes List) Resting (unfilled) nodes at this rate over time. Flat for a fully-unfilled rectangular order; piecewise when orders are partially filled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--best_ask--allocation_schedule_delta))
- `dollars_per_node_hour` (String) Price in dollars per node-hour, encoded as a decimal string. Prices are rounded to the nearest $0.000060/node-hour market tick. This is one microdollar per node-minute. Responses contain the rounded value with six decimal places. Inputs must contain a decimal point, be non-negative, and not exceed $500/node-hour.
- `instance_sku` (String) Instance SKU whose orders contributed to this price level.

<a id="nestedatt--best_ask--allocation_schedule_delta"></a>
### Nested Schema for `best_ask.allocation_schedule_delta`

Read-Only:

- `end_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `node_count` (Number)
- `start_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.

- `dollars_per_node_hour` (String) Price in dollars per node-hour, encoded as a decimal string. Prices are rounded to the nearest $0.000060/node-hour market tick. This is one microdollar per node-minute. Responses contain the rounded value with six decimal places. Inputs must contain a decimal point, be non-negative, and not exceed $500/node-hour.
